title: Sales Representative
description:
Trukai Industries Ltd is seeking for an enthusiastic and driven Sales Representative to join our Sales Team based in Tabubil, Western Province and will report directly to the Area Sales Manager.
As a Sales Representative, you will be responsible for the efficient day-to-day management of all sales, customer service and product image including the administration in your designated location.
Key Requirements
Diploma in Business or a related field
5 years’ experience in similar role
Previous Experience in an FMCG Company
Excellent sales and negotiation skills
Very good customer and interpersonal skills
Very good communication skills both oral and written
Very good report writing skills
Computer literate in Outlook, Microsoft Excel and MS Word
Must have a Current Class 6 Driver’s License
